{{Top|leg}}
A '''holotrophy''' was a type of award. [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] who won one of the [[Species/Legends|species]]' annual hunting awards, or [[Atiang/Legends|Atiang]], were awarded a holotrophy displaying the award.
